PRLS.description: Plate End Release (PRLS). The entity key is the plate element number; ITEMS is a list of release definitions for that element, each optionally tied to a boundary group by GROUP_NAME and carrying per-node DOF release flags N1..N4.

ITEMS.description: List of plate end release definitions for the element key. Each item sets the DOF release state at the plate's four node positions (N1..N4).

ID.description: Serial number of the release definition within this element. If a definition already exists for the resolved boundary group, that existing serial is reused.

GROUP_NAME.description: Boundary group name this release belongs to. Empty string means no group (group key 0). If non-empty it must be an existing boundary group name, otherwise the request is rejected.

N1.description: DOF release flags at plate node position 1. Five entries, each 1 = released, 0 = connected. Any non-zero value is treated as released. Order corresponds to the five plate DOF components (e.g. Fx, Fy, Fz, Mx, My).

N2.description: DOF release flags at plate node position 2. Five entries, each 1 = released, 0 = connected. Any non-zero value is treated as released. Order corresponds to the five plate DOF components (e.g. Fx, Fy, Fz, Mx, My).

N3.description: DOF release flags at plate node position 3. Five entries, each 1 = released, 0 = connected. Any non-zero value is treated as released. Order corresponds to the five plate DOF components (e.g. Fx, Fy, Fz, Mx, My).

N4.description: DOF release flags at plate node position 4. Five entries, each 1 = released, 0 = connected. Any non-zero value is treated as released. Order corresponds to the five plate DOF components (e.g. Fx, Fy, Fz, Mx, My).
